name: camphor (-)- + levomenthol + methyl salicylate
purpose: for temporary relief aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with: arthritis, simple backache, sprains, strains, bruises
uses: Adults and children 2 years of age and over: apply to the affected area no more than 3 to 4 times daily. Children under 2 years of age: consult a doctor
otcwarn: use only as directed do not bandage tightly or use with a healing pad avoid contact with the eyes and mucous membranes do not apply to wounds or damaged skin flammable
